entry.title: Query regarding Retrofit-SPS Upgarde
entry.content:
We are currently in progress with SPS upgrade (ECC EHP 8, SP25).

As part of it, we need to retrofit few changes (Programs, Smartforms etc.) in the upgraded Development system which were earlier carried out in non-upgraded Quality & Pre-Production systems.

For Programs (with minor changes): We use version management & manually copy the changes to upgraded development system.

For Programs (with multiple includes etc.): We use (TCD SE38 -> Utilities -> More Utilities -> Upload/Download) option to download from quality system & upload it to development system.

For Smartforms/Styles/Text: We use (TCD SMARTFORMS -> Utilities -> Upload/Download form/style/text) option to download from Quality & upload it to development system.

Please can anyone confirm whether the above approach is correct & whether it will have any impact on the ongoing SPS Upgrade.

entry.title: Discrepancy in DMEE Format Name Displayed in F110 DME Administration
entry.content:
Hi Team,

We have created a new DMEE format Z_CITI_CN_CGI_XML_CT_1 by copying the existing DMEE format Z_CITI_CN_CGI_XML_CT.

The new format has been configured and assigned as follows:

  • Assigned to the relevant country payment method in FBZP.
  • Corresponding entries have been created and maintained in OBPM1, OBPM3, and OBPM4 with the format name Z_CITI_CN_CGI_XML_CT_1.
  • The payment method is configured to use the new DMEE format.

During testing in F110, the system consistently updates and uses the new format Z_CITI_CN_CGI_XML_CT_1 in the following locations:

  1. Proposal Log
  2. Environment → Payment Media → Attributes
  3. Table REGUT (field DTFOR)
  4. Generated DMEE/XML file details
  5. Runtime data observed during debugging (field FPAYHX-FORMI contains value Z_CITI_CN_CGI_XML_CT_1)

entry.title: How to restrict cross-creation between Customers and Vendors in transaction BP (Without BAdIs)?
entry.content:
The Scenario and the Issue
I need to design two distinct and restricted authorization profiles for transaction BP:

Vendors Profile: The user must be strictly restricted to creating and modifying Vendors.

Customers Profile: The user must be strictly restricted to creating and modifying Customers.

The practical issue: Even after restricting the BP Roles in authorization object B_BUPA_RLT (allowing only FLVN* roles for vendors and FLCU* roles for customers), users assigned to the Vendor profile are still able to trigger the creation of Customer master data in the background (or vice versa), depending on the selected BP Grouping.

entry.title: SAP S/4 Hana Landscape - RISE (SAP Easy Access) — Bin-to-Bin Transfer; Multiple Destination Bins?
entry.content:
Hi all,

I'm a warehouse store-person who started using SAP Easy Access/EWM around one and a half years ago, and I'm looking to find out whether there is a way for a basic user to create an internal bin-to-bin transfer order that allows some/all of the following:

 

  • Multiple items/lines
  • Multiple destinations storage bins
  • Multiple source storage bins
  • Multiple material types
  • Partial transfer of stock from source storage bins

I'm mostly looking to be able to carry out the second action; bin-to-bin transfer of a large amount of one material in one source bin to multiple destination bins. E.g. multiple full pallets of one material (unable to be put-away in one location in the racking) goods receipted to a single storage bin, such as 'FLOOR', requiring bin-to-bin transfer to multiple destination storage bins. 

I have looked up previous question posts such as this one from 2013; https://community.sap.com/t5/enterprise-resource-planning-q-a/transfer-stock-to-the-multiple-bins/qaq-p/9592906, but have been unable to apply this to my own context/SAP EWM environment. One of the answers under the above linked post says; "LT01 should work for transferring the stock from one storage bin to multiple storage types bins and it will create only one TO,"  and this doesn't appear to be the case for the version I'm using as far as I can tell (recently updated to SAP S/4 Hana Landscape - RISE).

I'm wondering whether this is something that was changed in a previous update (the post being thirteen years ago), whether this is something that would be limited or customised by my employer, or whether I lack information about how these codes function. I have yet to find a guide explaining how the return storage bin/type within the UI of LT01 ("Backsp.") functions and its purpose.

Grateful for any help regarding this.
